## Skua (CR 1/3)

**XP** 135  
N Tiny animal  
**Init** +3; **Senses** low-light vision; Perception +10  


**Defense**


**AC** 15, touch 15, flat-footed 12 (+3 Dex, +2 size)  
**hp** 8 (1d8)  
**Fort** +2; **Ref** +5; **Will** +2  
**Speed** 10 ft., fly 50 ft. (good)  
**Melee** 2 talons +5 (1d4+3), bite +5 (1d3+3)  
**Special Attacks** dive-bomb  


**Statistics**


**Str** 6, **Dex**17, **Con**11, **Int**2, **Wis**14, **Cha**7  
**Base Atk** +0; **CMB** +6; **CMD** 9  
**Feats** Weapon Finesse  
*House rules: Weapon Finesse adds Dex instead of Str to finesse damage and CMB.*  
**Skills** Fly +11, Perception +10; Racial Modifiers +4 Perception  


**Special Abilities**


**Dive-Bomb (Ex)** When a charging skua confirms a critical hit, the creature hit must succeed on a DC 10 Fortitude saving throw or be blinded for 1d4 rounds.
